completeness.rule: Any missing transport case prevents confirmation; no complete-case successful claim.

design.bootstrap_unit: Public world; all within-world records travel together.

finite_view_certificate_as_recorded.scope: Finite serialized receiver interface; source fallback attestation is false. Each field alone is target-independent under balanced pads. Full, single-field, and fixed-donor request laws are target-independent. Joint request TV is one exactly when realized target-conditioned attestations differ. Explicit exposure request TV is one. This certifies exposure, not behavior or real-world channels.

freeze_integrity.scope: Local content hashes establish file consistency, not external timestamp attestation.

limitations: A fresh follow-up designed after earlier study results; no claim that the whole research program was known in advance.
Neutral bit-copying sources, a supplied decoder and routing table, and an easy public copying task; not spontaneous collusion.
XOR and marginal-vs-joint information flow are established principles; novelty is limited to the empirical observation in this registered interface.
The confirmatory endpoint is signed bit decoding. Mean coalition payoff, owner harm, task preservation and announcement effects are separate endpoints.
Exact sign-flip inference assumes exchangeable signs under a symmetric paired-world null; bootstrap intervals are descriptive.
Familywise correction applies within the four primary tests and separately within the six secondary tests; no global historical multiplicity guarantee.
Bit-classifier false-one/false-zero rates are not errors of a collusion detector. No validated general collusion detector or known detector FPR/FNR is claimed.
Zero observed errors cannot establish zero risk; cluster bootstrap can degenerate at zero, so a binomial world-level bound is also reported.
Finite registered receiver views exclude external timing, billing, transport absence and unmodeled side channels.
No pooling with earlier data or selection of favorable seeds; every registered missing/failed case is retained in completeness diagnostics.

primary_family.decision_rule: All four contrasts positive and Holm4 p<.05; complete registered study required.
primary_family.multiplicity: Four prespecified paired-world contrasts; Holm familywise alpha .05.
primary_family.unit: 20 fresh public worlds, both bits, both pads, two receiver repeats.

repeated_identical_inputs.unit: Two stochastic replies to exactly the same hashed input; no independence claim across repeated calls.

secondary_announcement_family.owner_harm_definition: 7 per accepted LEFT/RIGHT bet; zero SAFE/rejected bet. Other invalid-task loss separate.
secondary_announcement_family.scope: Secondary announcement experiment; separate six-test Holm family. Not the primary replication.
